subject.title: [Feature]: Cost metadata support for auto-discovered Amazon Bedrock models

question: Which pricing-overlay API should OpenClaw support for auto-discovered Amazon Bedrock models?
rationale: The fix adds a new user-facing provider/config contract, and automation should not choose between a narrow Bedrock plugin-local overlay and a broader generic model-cost overlay without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use Bedrock plugin discovery costs
options.body: Add a costs map under the Amazon Bedrock plugin discovery config keyed by model/profile ID, with schema, docs, cache-key, discovery, and regression coverage.

options.title: Use a generic model cost overlay
options.body: Add a top-level overlay that can patch discovered models across providers, accepting a broader config surface and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep explicit provider pricing only
options.body: Decline a new overlay and document that users must define explicit provider model entries for local cost estimates.

recommendation.title: Use Bedrock plugin discovery costs
recommendation.body: Add a costs map under the Amazon Bedrock plugin discovery config keyed by model/profile ID, with schema, docs, cache-key, discovery, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current plugin-owned config migration and schema boundary history point to this owner for the config-shape decision.
